description:
Successful datagen-only runs (--phases generate) produce results JSON with
near-zero metrics: run.total_duration_ms is always 0, phases.data_generation
has only {"status": "COMPLETED"} with no duration_ms, and no per-table stats
are surfaced anywhere.

Three distinct bugs prevent existing timing and manifest data from reaching
the JSON output:

1. duration_seconds kwarg silently dropped: runner.py captures datagen_duration
   and passes it to create_enhanced_benchmark_result(), but that method does
   not declare duration_seconds as an explicit parameter - it lands in **kwargs
   and is never extracted. ResultBuilder._calculate_duration() then returns 0.0
   (no query times, no loading time). Fix: add set_total_duration() to builder
   and wire the param through.

2. duration_ms missing from phases dict: runner.py passes
   phases={"data_generation": {"status": "COMPLETED"}} without duration_ms.
   Fix: include "duration_ms": int(datagen_duration * 1000) in the dict.

3. Manifest-level per-table stats never surfaced: the manifest
   (_datagen_manifest.json) written by every generator contains per-file
   row_count and size_bytes. After _ensure_data_generated() completes these
   sit on disk but are never read back. Fix: add _read_datagen_stats_from_manifest()
   helper that aggregates tables_generated, total_rows, total_size_bytes and
   merges them into the phases dict.

anti_patterns.dont: change _ensure_data_generated return type or call conventions
anti_patterns.instead: add the manifest helper as a separate function
anti_patterns.why: runner logic for reuse/force-regen depends on the bool return
stats are non-critical and a crash would block all datagen runs

anti_patterns.dont: read the manifest eagerly in every code path
anti_patterns.instead: only call _read_datagen_stats_from_manifest in the data_only branch
anti_patterns.why: manifest may not exist for all run types

anti_patterns.dont: rename or remove the **kwargs parameter from create_enhanced_benchmark_result
anti_patterns.why: many call sites pass platform-specific kwargs

ResultBuilder._calculate_duration() fallback logic (start/end times, then query time sum) remains intact for non-datagen paths
Standard benchmark runs (load+power) report correct total_duration_ms and phase timings - no regression
_ensure_data_generated() return type (bool) and calling convention in runner.py unchanged

phases.data_generation.duration_ms present and > 0 in result JSON

Full test suite passes with no regression
